questions.question: Which 1997 film features the line 'I'm the king of the world!'?
questions.explanation: Jack Dawson shouts it at the bow of the ship in James Cameron's Titanic.

questions.question: Who directed the 1993 film 'Jurassic Park'?
questions.explanation: Spielberg directed Jurassic Park, adapted from Michael Crichton's novel.

questions.question: Which animated film features the song 'Let It Go'?
questions.explanation: 'Let It Go' is sung by Elsa in Disney's Frozen (2013).

questions.question: In Disney's 'The Lion King' (1994), what is the name of Simba's villainous uncle?
questions.explanation: Scar is Mufasa's younger brother and the film's villain.

questions.question: Which studio made 'Toy Story' (1995)?
questions.explanation: Toy Story was Pixar's first feature film, produced with Disney.

questions.question: Which film series features a school called Hogwarts?
questions.explanation: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry is Harry Potter's school.

questions.question: Which film features a clownfish who gets lost and is searched for by his father?
questions.explanation: Marlin searches the ocean for his son Nemo in Pixar's Finding Nemo (2003).

questions.question: Who says 'I'll be back' in 'The Terminator' (1984)?
questions.explanation: Schwarzenegger played the T-800 and the line became his trademark.

questions.question: Which green ogre lives in a swamp in a 2001 animated film?
questions.explanation: Shrek (2001) was made by DreamWorks Animation.

questions.question: Which actor plays Captain Jack Sparrow in 'Pirates of the Caribbean'?
questions.explanation: Depp earned an Oscar nomination for the first film in 2003.

questions.question: Which 2018 Marvel film is set mostly in the fictional nation of Wakanda?
questions.explanation: Black Panther was directed by Ryan Coogler.

questions.question: Who directed 'The Godfather' (1972)?
questions.explanation: Coppola co-wrote the film with Mario Puzo, who wrote the novel.

questions.question: In the 1999 film 'The Matrix', which pill does Neo take to learn the truth?
questions.explanation: Morpheus offers Neo a choice between a blue and a red pill.

questions.question: Which actor played Forrest Gump?
questions.explanation: Hanks won the Best Actor Oscar for Forrest Gump (1994).

questions.question: In 'Back to the Future', what speed must the DeLorean reach to time travel?
questions.explanation: Doc Brown's time machine needs 88 mph and 1.21 gigawatts.

questions.question: Who directed 'Inception' (2010)?
questions.explanation: Nolan also directed The Dark Knight trilogy and Oppenheimer.

questions.question: Which film won the Academy Award for Best Picture for 2023 (awarded in March 2024)?
questions.explanation: Oppenheimer won seven Oscars including Best Picture and Best Director.

questions.question: Which Japanese studio is behind 'Spirited Away' and 'My Neighbor Totoro'?
questions.explanation: Studio Ghibli was co-founded by Hayao Miyazaki and Isao Takahata.

questions.question: Which film festival awards the Palme d'Or?
questions.explanation: The Palme d'Or is the top prize of the Cannes Film Festival in France.

questions.question: Which actress played Katniss Everdeen in 'The Hunger Games' films?
questions.explanation: The first film came out in 2012.

questions.question: Which 1977 film introduced Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader to audiences?
choices: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
questions.explanation: George Lucas's Star Wars was released in May 1977.

questions.question: Which of these films did NOT win 11 Academy Awards?
choices: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
questions.explanation: Those three each won 11 Oscars; Gladiator won five.

questions.question: Who directed the 2019 film 'Parasite', the first non-English-language winner of Best Picture?
questions.explanation: Parasite also won the Palme d'Or in 2019.

questions.question: Who directed '2001: A Space Odyssey' (1968)?
questions.explanation: Kubrick co-wrote the screenplay with Arthur C. Clarke.

questions.question: Which actress has won the most Academy Awards for acting, with four?
questions.explanation: Hepburn won four Best Actress Oscars; Streep has three.

questions.question: Which Alfred Hitchcock film features the Bates Motel?
questions.explanation: Psycho was released in 1960 with Anthony Perkins as Norman Bates.

questions.question: Who composed the music for the original 'Star Wars' (1977)?
questions.explanation: Williams also scored Jaws, E.T. and Indiana Jones.

questions.question: Who played the Joker in 'The Dark Knight' (2008)?
questions.explanation: Ledger won a posthumous Oscar for the role.

questions.question: Which 1941 film, about a newspaper tycoon, is often ranked among the greatest ever made?
questions.explanation: Orson Welles directed, co-wrote and starred in Citizen Kane.

questions.question: Which Japanese director made 'Seven Samurai' (1954)?
questions.explanation: Seven Samurai inspired the Hollywood western The Magnificent Seven.

questions.question: Which 2000s Pixar film features a rat who wants to become a chef in Paris?
questions.explanation: Remy the rat cooks with the help of Linguini in Ratatouille (2007).

questions.question: Which was the first feature-length film made entirely with computer animation?
questions.explanation: Toy Story (1995) was the first fully CGI feature film.

questions.question: Which French film from 2001 stars Audrey Tautou as a Parisian waitress who helps others?
questions.explanation: Jean-Pierre Jeunet directed Le Fabuleux Destin d'Amélie Poulain.

questions.question: Which film features the line 'Here's looking at you, kid'?
questions.explanation: Humphrey Bogart says it to Ingrid Bergman in Casablanca (1942).

questions.question: Who directed 'Lawrence of Arabia' (1962)?
questions.explanation: Lean also directed The Bridge on the River Kwai and Doctor Zhivago.

questions.question: Which 1931 horror film made Boris Karloff famous as the monster?
questions.explanation: James Whale directed Frankenstein for Universal Pictures.

questions.question: Which director made the 1982 science-fiction noir 'Blade Runner'?
questions.explanation: Blade Runner is based on Philip K. Dick's novel 'Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?'.

questions.question: Which actor starred in 'Gladiator' (2000) as Maximus?
questions.explanation: Crowe won the Best Actor Oscar for Gladiator.

questions.question: Which trilogy by Peter Jackson is based on novels by J. R. R. Tolkien?
questions.explanation: The films came out between 2001 and 2003.

questions.question: Which film features a toy cowboy named Woody?
questions.explanation: Woody is voiced by Tom Hanks in the Toy Story films.
